kinds.a: narrow tractor · tracteur fruitier · tracteur vigneron · Schmalspurtraktor
kinds.d: Wheeled tractor with a narrow track and low profile for working between vines and fruit trees.
Tractor with high ground clearance that straddles rows of vines or crops.
Low, wide tractor with a low centre of gravity that carries mowers and implements on steep ground.
Wheeled tractor built and guarded for forest work such as winching and skidding; also shown under Forestry.
Self-propelled carrier that carries and drives implements, with no load body; a Unimog with a load bed is in Vehicles.

notes: Restraint only. Pellenc OPTIMUM numbers cut to the OPTIMUM range; Aebi Schmidt Terratrac sizes and Reform Metrac models cut to their ranges (names taken from the old model list). Fendt 200 V/F/P kept as the three narrow-tractor forms and mirrored as types.
